lineups.name: Red Room
lineups.notes: W + jumpthrow from T spawn (Refrag). Aim at the dark gap between the bricks, top right of the door (Refrag). The chapter title is plural, so the clip may show several spawn spots.

lineups.name: Mid Donut
lineups.notes: From the left corner of T Spawn, behind the river; W + jump throw. Aim at the edge of the building in front (CS2Pulse, Tradeit). The chapter title is plural, so the clip may show other spots too.

lineups.name: Heaven
lineups.notes: Standing jump throw, left click (cs2util lists it as the Window smoke from T Spawn; Refrag: jumpthrow from the same spawn as Red). The exact spot is not named in the video chapter.

lineups.name: CT Lane
lineups.notes: Jump throw from the corner outside A Main; the CT, Donut and Temple smokes can all be thrown from this corner (BLAST). CS2Pulse throws a CT smoke from the Donut door instead. Technique is from the articles, not the video.

lineups.name: A Donut
lineups.notes: Jump throw from the left side of the stairs at the A Main entrance; aim at the gap in the hollowed wall (CS2Pulse, Tradeit). Refrag lists W + jumpthrow from the same corner as Temple.

lineups.name: Temple
lineups.notes: From the left corner of A Main: crouch first, then W + jump throw; aim at the top right of the leaf (CS2Pulse, Tradeit). Refrag lists a plain jumpthrow aimed at the thin gap between the leaves.

lineups.name: B Long
lineups.notes: Run two steps, then jump throw (cs2util, CS2Pulse); a hard lineup. cs2util: setpos -735.97 -2135.97 -104.40; setang -35.39 50.53. Spot is from the articles, not the video chapter.

lineups.name: B Short
lineups.notes: Stand still and jump throw with left click; blocks CT rotations through Mid and CT Spawn (cs2util). cs2util: setpos 1255.97 -1479.84 89.95; setang -6.10 109.20. Spot is from the article, not the video chapter.

lineups.name: Cave
lineups.notes: Two-step walking jump throw from the right side of the pillar under the bridge in T Spawn (CS2Pulse, Tradeit); mouse button not stated, left assumed. Another CS2Pulse page throws a Cave smoke from Water instead.

lineups.name: Cheetah
lineups.notes: Jump throw from the back left corner of T Spawn; aim at the tip of the building (CS2Pulse, Tradeit). Movement before the jump is not stated in the sources, so technique not stated in source.

lineups.name: Elbow
lineups.notes: Instant smoke from CT spawn 5: Shift + W (a tap of W, not held), then jump throw (MisterT, cs2util). Video description: setpos -512 1696 88.76; setang -26.77 -101.74.

lineups.name: B Doors
lineups.notes: Instant smoke from CT spawn: press W for two steps, then left-click jump throw (cs2util, spawn C). The video does not say which spawn it uses, so technique not stated in source.
